lines.name: Skyport Line
lines.beyond: west to the West End along Circus Road

notes: Kept from the current plan: T1 on the Boulevard reservation (x 0, Boulevard w 28, from sheet edge z -780) turning on the circus balloon. Its R 25 and R 28 bends are at or above radiusLoop 25. Corners (±28, 28) at r 28 make a 28 m arc centred on the circus, inside the 31 m island. The loop joins both tracks at ±1.8 (trackCentres 3.6). Also kept: S1 as one straight trunk over the Circus Road median, the circus island, the Crown Parade mall and the Skyport Pier and apron, turning on an R 40 loop over the water. No line has a dead end: T1 leaves at z -780, S1 leaves at x -400.

One change: S1's trunk now runs to x 575 instead of 560, and the loop starts at x 575. The loop is the same shape. All bends are still R 40 or more, the first fillet still fits (25 m segment against an 18.1 m tangent), and x 575 is still over the apron quay (x 480 to 590). This makes room for a 50 m Skyport station further east, because the stations as placed now sit 190 m apart (Harbour 340, Skyport 530), below stationSpacing min 200.

Not adopted from tide's draft, the two-way Sky Loop round the district. Going round the district takes the beam over plots and drops pylons onto whatever is underneath, which breaks S-C1 and S-P2 (the plan's 'why' note records this). One straight trunk over public space does the job with every pylon in a median, mall, island, quay or water zone.

Not adopted (yet), the T2 Harbour Line on Harbour Road. No rule needs it. It would also need a turning loop in street space at its south end, because Harbour Road stops at Comet Row (z -720) and does not reach the sheet edge (z -780); a block loop through Comet Row, the Boulevard and Market Street would share T1's street. If the checker's transit.reach (250) fails for the Harbour, Docks or Lantern areas once Vantage places stops, add more T1 stops first, then reconsider T2.
Interchange (N-C1): T1 stop 'circus' at (0, -72) to S1 'Crown Circus' at (95, 0) is about 119 m, within skyrail.interchange 150.

Source conflict for Aster: the plan's notes › why passage describes an older state (single track, no loop, Sphere sky loop, separate harbour line). It contradicts the current lines and notes › concept. It looks stale; it should be marked historical or removed.

Checker risk: the crown-circus road 'via' is a chord polygon ((0,-37), (-37,0), (0,37), back to (0,-37)), not a ring. If T-C1 reads it literally, the T1 loop's diagonal between (-1.8,-45) and (-28,-19) runs about 6 to 7 m off that chord (half-width 6) and just outside the 31 m island. If T-C1 fails there, the fix is to redraw the circus road as a ring (radius 37, w 12), not to loosen the rule.
Evidence: I have no shell in this run, so I did not run the plan checker. These checks are worked by hand against the standards. Next step: `bun tools/plan/cli.ts` must exit 0.

handoffs.ask: S1 stations break stationSpacing [200, 500]: Harbour (340) to Skyport (530) is 190 m. The S1 trunk now runs to x 575. Move Skyport to about x 545 (a 50 m station fits 520 to 570 on the apron) so Harbour to Skyport is at least 200 m. Or move Harbour to about x 325. Keep Crown Circus to Harbour at 200 m or more.

When you place stops, check transit.reach 250 for the Harbour, Docks and Lantern areas. If any area is out of reach, add a T1 stop on the Boulevard trunk (spacing 300 to 500) before asking for a T2 Harbour Road line.
